checks.name: modal_drawer_focus
checks.detail: Navigation, members and search use modal semantics only with a visible scrim; focus enters the panel, wraps at the Tab boundaries, background regions become inert and prior focus is restored.

checks.name: nested_nonmodal_surfaces
checks.detail: Escape in a member popover stops propagation to its parent drawer. The reset-link result moves focus to the link and returns it after close.

checks.name: keyboard_shortcuts
checks.detail: Push-to-talk ignores fields, buttons, selects and dialogs; Ctrl/Meta+K ignores editable controls and dialogs.

checks.name: frontend_suite_and_build
checks.detail: npm test: 157 files, 460 tests passed. npm run build: TypeScript and Vite passed.

limitations: Unit and source tests do not prove browser focus order, visibility or screen-reader announcements.
